excerpt: Agile Manifesto principles applied to BA work: embracing change, continuous collaboration, iterative discovery, and working software over documentation.

excerpt: Lightweight documentation in agile: living backlogs, wiki pages, just-in-time elaboration, and balancing documentation with conversation.

excerpt: BA participation in sprint reviews (demo feedback, acceptance), and retrospectives (process improvement, elicitation effectiveness).

excerpt: Estimation techniques: story points, planning poker, t-shirt sizing, relative estimation, and right-sizing stories for sprint commitment.

title: The BA Role in Scrum
excerpt: How BAs fit into Scrum teams, relationship with Product Owner, participating in sprints, and balancing analysis with delivery cadence.

title: Case Study: Agile Transformation
excerpt: Transitioning from waterfall to agile: BA role evolution, backlog creation from BRDs, coaching teams, managing cultural resistance, and lessons learned.

excerpt: End-to-end process redesign using Lean Six Sigma DMAIC: baseline metrics, waste elimination, automation opportunities, and achieving ROI targets.

excerpt: Complete BA walkthrough: stakeholder analysis, usability requirements, A/B testing criteria, payment gateway integration, and measuring conversion lift.

excerpt: SOX compliance project: working with auditors, defining internal controls, traceability to regulations, validation requirements, and audit trail reporting.

title: Case Study: Healthcare EMR Integration
excerpt: Electronic Medical Records integration: HIPAA compliance, HL7 messaging standards, clinical workflow analysis, and managing physician stakeholders.

title: Lessons Learned from Failed Projects
